comments:
The script and image quality make it difficult do read.
The manuscript is preserved at Sera monastery ([S635TW6P]: 84).

A post-colophon addition states: dpal ldan nag chung rjes 'brang rgyan kyis mdo' bsal ba'i || ti ka blo 'i mun sel rin cen sgron me 'di..."

name: yum bar ma nyi khri mngon rtogs rgyan dang sbyar ba'i TIk+ka
item_description:
Volume letter: ka.
Folio numbers (written out in letters) unclear on most folios. A second set of numbers for pages was added with Tibetan numbers, and yet another (likely on the copy) in Arabic numbers.
Two folios numbered 12. Two folios numbered 23.
Some folios are by another hand (e.g., fol. 21, fol. 40, fol. 64) and could belong to another manuscript.
Lines per folio: 10 and more, with interlinear notes.
